import pandas as pd

# Extract the starting year from "years for jazz" (e.g., "2007", "1996 - 99")
start_years = pd.to_numeric(
    df["years for jazz"].astype(str).str.extract(r"(\d{4})")[0],
    errors="coerce",
)

# US players who started after 1985
us_after = df[
    (df["nationality"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == "united states")
    & (start_years > 1985)
]

count_ok = len(us_after) == 4

# Filter for the player louis amundson explicitly
amundson = df[df["player"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == "louis amundson"]

# He must be one of the US players after 1985 and be the most recent
amundson_start = start_years[amundson.index]
in_us_after = amundson.index.isin(us_after.index).any()
recent_ok = in_us_after and amundson_start.max() >= start_years[us_after.index].max()

answer = bool(count_ok and recent_ok)
~~~
